title: pulqui
description: `pulqui` reads a WAV file and generates a companion data file for use by `pulqui-limiter.pd`. Send `read <path/file>` to its inlet; on success, the first outlet reports the generated filename, while the second outputs a `bang` on error. The output is written beside the source with `f` appended to its name and retains the source’s 16-, 24-, or 32-bit floating-point depth.
